title: Survey of planetesimal belts with ALMA: gas detected around the Sun-like star HD 129590
question: Do debris discs around later-type stars host secondary CO/CN gas, and what are the dust and gas properties of 10 planetesimal-belt systems?

what.value: Stellar parameters, fractional luminosities and SEDs for the sample

evidence.quote: References: From (cite: 2017MNRAS.469..521K) updated with GAIA DR2 distances

what.value: JCMT 850 micron flux of HD 15745 (12±1.4 mJy)

evidence.quote: Extrapolating the observed JCMT flux for HD 15745 at 850 $\mu$m ($12\pm1.4$ mJy) to 1.27 mm

recipe.method: Combine four SPWs excluding CO line channels, CLEAN with natural weighting, integrate flux in ellipse where S/N >~2

recipe.goal: Fit dust ring geometry and mass
recipe.method: Gaussian ring model, RADMC-3D images at 1.27 mm fit to dirty images with MCMC
assumptions: size distribution index -3.5, max grain 1 cm, min = blowout size, astrosilicates 2.7 g/cm3, kappa~1.3 cm2/g

recipe.goal: Extract CO/CN moment maps, spectra and fluxes
recipe.method: uvcontsub cubes, moment-0 integrated over ±20 km/s refined per source, upper limits 3 sigma

recipe.goal: Fit gas disc with LTE radiative transfer MCMC
recipe.method: Gaussian ring gas model, RADMC-3D CO cubes vs dirty cubes, per channel
key_parameters: 100 walkers, ~10,000 steps; 2.667 channels per resolution element

recipe.method: Optically thin non-LTE with fluorescence, scan over electron density and Tk 10-250 K, take min/max
assumptions: collision rates from Dickinson & Richards 1975, Allison & Dalgarno 1971

recipe.goal: Derive planetesimal CO ice fraction and HCN/CO
recipe.method: Steady-state gas vs dust production using Matra et al. 2017 Eq. 2 and 2018 Eq. 3

evidence.quote: we find that (the optically thin) mass range is $2.1\times10^{-5}$ - $1.3\times10^{-4}$ M$_\oplus$

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels for continuum and uvcontsub
Image size, cell size, clean threshold
MCMC priors ranges and burn-in length
Velocity binning of cubes and masks used for fluxes
Stellar models for non-LTE fluorescence and electron density grid
missing_for_reproduction: MCMC priors and non-LTE grid ranges
score_reason: Public data and clear model description, but many imaging and fitting settings are missing and the gas fits need weeks of CPU.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric results (fluxes, masses, radii); continuum and CO flux are redoable.
